site.name: Agassiz Mine
site.location: Fryer Hill, Leadville Mining District, Lake County
overview: Agassiz Mine is a documented historic underground mine on Fryer Hill in the Leadville mining district. A USGS Mineral Resources Data System record places the site near 39.24833, -106.27111 and classifies the patented property as a past producer with zinc recorded as a commodity.

timeline.event: A Leadville newspaper's weekly ore-output report listed the Agassiz among producing mines.
The U.S. Geological Survey's Geology and Mining Industry of Leadville documented the district and mapped mining on Fryer Hill.
USGS Professional Paper 148 provided a later comprehensive account of Leadville geology and ore deposits and is retained in the federal Agassiz mine record's bibliography.

moreHistory: The reviewed evidence consistently places the Agassiz on Fryer Hill in the Leadville district. The federal mine record identifies a patented, underground, past-producing property and supplies a specific mapped site point.

Available sources do not establish a dependable operator chronology, production total, detailed workings description, or present condition. The mapped point is a historic site-level reference and should not be treated as a surveyed safe or accessible opening.
